title: Red panda wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#c4502a'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#f2a06b'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='78' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#a83e1f' transform='rotate(-15 27 78)'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='78' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#a83e1f' transform='rotate(15 73 78)'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='86' r='5' fill='#3a2a28'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='86' r='5' fill='#3a2a28'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#c4502a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='30' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#a83e1f'/>
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='30' rx='4.5' ry='5' fill='#f2a06b'/>
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='30' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#a83e1f'/>
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='30' rx='4.5' ry='5' fill='#f2a06b'/>
  <!-- face white patches -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='52' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#fbe3cc'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='52' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#fbe3cc'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='50' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#2f2a44'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='50' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#2f2a44'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='48.5' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='48.5' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='4.5' ry='3' fill='#2f2a44'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='8' ry='5.5' fill='#fbe3cc'/>
  <path d='M46 61 Q50 65 54 61' stroke='#a83e1f' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='57' r='4' fill='#f06a6a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='57' r='4' fill='#f06a6a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M42 22 L50 4 L58 22 Z' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <path d='M44 17 L56 17' stroke='#e84545' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <path d='M46 12 L54 12' stroke='#4a90d9' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='4' r='3.5' fill='#e84545'/>
  <!-- hat base band -->
  <rect x='41' y='20' width='18' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4a90d9'/>
</svg>
